# GraphEvent

`schemas/records/graph-event.json`

The payload of every artifact-graph event (docs/design/m0/13), discriminated by type: node.recorded/v1, node.claimed/v1, node.invalidated/v1, node.hold_raised/v1, node.hold_paged/v1 and node.hold_cleared/v1 under the node's id, node.hold_transferred/v1 under the receiving node's, result.recorded/v1 and result.selected/v1 under the result's id; each in the node's project. internal/graph folds them into the graph projections in the writer transaction and refuses one its state does not derive.

A document is one of: [NodeRecorded](#noderecorded) or [NodeClaimed](#nodeclaimed) or [NodeInvalidated](#nodeinvalidated) or [HoldRaised](#holdraised) or [HoldPaged](#holdpaged) or [HoldCleared](#holdcleared) or [HoldTransferred](#holdtransferred) or [ResultRecorded](#resultrecorded) or [ResultSelected](#resultselected).

## Definitions

### NodeRecorded

A node joins its task's graph, append-only: its task, its project and the node it succeeds (null for a first round).

#### Fields of NodeRecorded

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `node_recorded` |  |
| `node` | yes | [node](records-node.md) |  |
| `task` | yes | [TaskID](common-defs.md#taskid) |  |
| `project` | yes | [ProjectID](common-defs.md#projectid) |  |
| `predecessor` | yes | null or [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### NodeClaimed

A node's claim on its computation key (13 [G10]): its inputs as they resolved, fixed from here on, and the key they give. A claim is a node instance's: a repeat demand of the node joins it and records nothing; a memoizable kind's key is claimed once per task.

#### Fields of NodeClaimed

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `node_claimed` |  |
| `node` | yes | [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |
| `key` | yes | [computation-key](records-computation-key.md) |  |
| `inputs` | yes | array of object ([fields](#fields-of-nodeclaimedinputs)) | Each declared input and what it resolved to, in declared order: a result, or an approval with its revision. A new kind of resolution is a new event version (node.claimed/v2), since every field is required. |

No other fields are allowed.

#### Fields of NodeClaimed.inputs[]

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | yes | [Name](records-receipt.md#name) |  |
| `result` | yes | null or [ResultID](common-defs.md#resultid) |  |
| `approval` | yes | null or [ApprovalID](common-defs.md#approvalid) |  |
| `revision` | yes | null or integer (minimum `1`, maximum `9007199254740991`) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### NodeInvalidated

An explicit, recorded invalidation (13 [G1]): the node's claim moves to the next generation, with the same inputs, so its key changes and its selected result, if any, no longer answers it.

#### Fields of NodeInvalidated

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `node_invalidated` |  |
| `node` | yes | [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |
| `key` | yes | [computation-key](records-computation-key.md) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### HoldRaised

An external wait on the node (02 "Hold reasons and resume signals"): raised at the event's time, by its registry owner, with no page yet. A hold with a reason is the retry wait of the node's could_not_run result (13 [G2]), and its reason's registry entry names it.

#### Fields of HoldRaised

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `hold_raised` |  |
| `node` | yes | [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |
| `hold` | yes | [node-hold](records-node-hold.md) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### HoldPaged

A page of the hold at the event's time, for its signal instance: to its owner, or to the registry's escalate_to, which then owns it.

#### Fields of HoldPaged

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `hold_paged` |  |
| `node` | yes | [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |
| `hold` | yes | [HoldID](common-defs.md#holdid) |  |
| `owner` | yes | [Owner](vocab-registry.md#owner) |  |
| `owner_ref` | yes | null or string (minLength `1`, maxLength `256`) |  |
| `channel` | yes | null or [Name](records-receipt.md#name) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### HoldCleared

The hold's signal arrived, or its wait no longer applies: the hold leaves the node.

#### Fields of HoldCleared

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `hold_cleared` |  |
| `node` | yes | [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |
| `hold` | yes | [HoldID](common-defs.md#holdid) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### HoldTransferred

A hold moves to another node of the task (13 supersession) with its id, signal instance, owner and paging history.

#### Fields of HoldTransferred

| `hold` | yes | [HoldID](common-defs.md#holdid) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

### ResultRecorded

An immutable result of a claimed node, with the attempt that produced it (null for a controller node).

#### Fields of ResultRecorded

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `result_recorded` |  |
| `node` | yes | [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |
| `result` | yes | [result](records-result.md) |  |
| `attempt` | yes | null or [AttemptID](common-defs.md#attemptid) | Checked by this schema only until M1 binds attempts to nodes. |

No other fields are allowed.

### ResultSelected

The node selects its result: a completed result that is not could_not_run (13 [G2]), answering the node's current key, once per claim.

#### Fields of ResultSelected

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | yes | `result_selected` |  |
| `node` | yes | [NodeID](common-defs.md#nodeid) |  |
| `result` | yes | [ResultID](common-defs.md#resultid) |  |

No other fields are allowed.
